summary: Iteration 4: tested seasonal hero videos, Edit Spotlight, Rent where+dates search, per-bag totals, protection plans + pickup/delivery in booking card & quote, Make an Offer (accept/counter/decline/422 rules), owner closet pages + follow, Top Lender badges, lender protection on /lend, plus regressions (catalogue, quick view closet link, buy catalogue, 390px mobile). Backend 36/36 pytest pass (13 existing + 23 new). All requested frontend flows work; only minor UX/design nits found.

minor.issue: Counter uses Python round() (banker's rounding): e.g. 7030 on 8900 asking -> (7965/10=796.5) rounds to 7960 instead of 7970. Use int(x/10+0.5)*10 for consistent half-up rounding (frontend round10 uses Math.round half-up).
Review request mentioned GET /api/lenders/jadori-marketplace--0yaojot9 (likely template typo). Tested /api/lenders/eleanor-v (200, 3 listings) and /api/lenders/unknown (404) instead.

ui_bugs.issue: Sticky bottom CTA always reads 'Select dates' even when dates are prefilled from ?from&to (and booking total is already shown). Consider 'Request to rent · $1,231' when dates exist.
acceptCounter has no try/catch; a failed POST /offers/{id}/accept-counter leaves busy=true forever and throws unhandled rejection with no error shown.

issues: Season preview switcher at top-right is clipped: 'Autumn' runs off the right edge.
Meta row wraps so the '|' separator is orphaned at the start of the second line ('| Replies within an hour').
rent-search bar sits below the fold (~y=830 at 1080px) under the large hero; consider pulling it up/overlapping hero so where+dates search is immediately visible.
Rental request rows don't show chosen protection plan / handoff (stored in backend) - only total; nice-to-have.

action_items: (Low) Add try/catch + error display to OfferDialog.acceptCounter
(Low) Use half-up rounding for counter offer in owner_reply
(Low) Fix mobile hero season switcher overflow and closet meta separator wrapping
(Low) Mobile sticky booking CTA label when dates prefilled
critical_code_review_comments: EditSpotlight http.get('/listings') has no .catch -> skeleton tiles forever on API failure
Each EditSpotlight mount fetches all listings to pick 3; acceptable for 12 sample items
Deposit rounding consistent between backend (int(x/50+0.5)) and frontend (Math.floor(x/50+0.5)) - verified totals match (1231/947/1866)

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows (minor UX nits only)

seed_data_creation: Created test records (no delete endpoints exist): rental_requests and offers with emails test_iter4@example.com, test_iter4_offer@example.com, test_ui_iter4@example.com; names prefixed TEST_.

Rent search city select option values are plain city names (labels 'Boston, MA'); calendar uses button[name=next-month] and button[name=day]. Follows stored in localStorage key jadori_following.
